title: Define activation report and installed/active state schema
purpose: Define the reports and state files that distinguish staged artifacts from active runtime behavior.
scope: Define staging, activation, deactivation and rollback reports.
Bind active artifacts to audit range, approval and rollback handles.
acceptance_criteria: Active state can be reconstructed after restart.
Activation report includes audit range and rollback handle.
failure_modes: Active and staged state are conflated.
